composition_subtypes.role: Graph traversal (BFS) to generate layer groups for each root
DP to count k-choices from groups in a layer

payload.core_composition_summary: BFS groups tree nodes by ancestor in layers; DP counts ways to choose k nodes from these groups.
payload.rationale: The solution first uses BFS to compute layer groups, then DP over these groups to count combinations, so both mechanisms are essential.
